svg.title: What we found: where CDC wins, where it loses, and a gap in the product
svg.desc: CDC wins on the content and the order of a change. It loses on counting and on attribution. We also found a real gap: the operator sees the replication slot grow but still reports it healthy.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A GAP WE FOUND IN THE PRODUCT TODAY

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A slow consumer makes the replication slot retain WAL. The disk can fill,

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and Postgres goes read-only. We measured it grow:

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 64 kB → 1953 kB over 6 ticks

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The operator SEES the slot grow,

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: but still reports it HEALTHY. It does not warn.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fixable next, and independent of everything else.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
